name: Aave Position Monitor
description: Check any wallet's Aave V3 position on Arbitrum. Returns health factor, collateral, debt, available borrows, and risk status with actionable recommendations.

check_position.description: Fetch live Aave V3 position data for a wallet on Arbitrum. Returns health factor, collateral and debt in USD, and a risk status with recommendation.

price_change_24h.description: Optional ETH price change in the last 24h (percentage). Enriches the recommendation.

wallet.description: The wallet address that was checked

health_factor.description: Aave health factor. Below 1.0 means liquidatable.

status.description: Risk status: safe, warning, danger, or liquidatable

recommendation.description: Human-readable advice based on current position

has_position.description: Whether the wallet has an active Aave V3 position
